Hi James — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a few follow-ups so your security/procurement team has the details they asked for.

Key bullets from today:
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II. We can share the SOC 2 report under NDA — attaching a short SOC 2 summary for now.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support GDPR DSARs and have a BAA available for HIPAA-covered customers; happy to route legal to legal when you're ready.
- Data deletion SLA: customer-initiated deletion requests are processed within 30 days; full purging from backups is completed within 90 days by default (we can discuss acceleration for contract terms).
- Logs & backups: application logs (for debugging/alerts) are kept for 90 days by default; audit logs required for compliance can be retained longer via paid retention add-on. Backups are encrypted at rest (KMS) and follow the 90-day retention/rotation schedule.

Requested next steps:
1) Please share Amaya's vendor security questionnaire — we can start populating it.
2) If procurement wants written language for deletion SLAs or BAA terms, I can loop in Rishi and legal.
3) Propose a 30-minute follow-up next Wed (Mar 31) to review answers and outstanding technical items.

I've attached the SOC2 summary (Redwood-SOC2-summary-2025.pdf) and would be happy to provide the full report under NDA.

Thanks — I will also start the vendor questionnaire fill and loop in our security/infra folks.

Neha — thanks for the flag. Draft answers below you can use in the questionnaire and share with Amaya; happy to be looped into any follow-ups from their security/legal team.

SOC 2
- Redwood Inference is SOC 2 Type II compliant (security & availability). We provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. Please see our one-page SOC2 summary attached (Redwood-SOC2-summary-2025.pdf). To request the full report, we use a standard NDA and a short evidence request; typical turnaround is 3–5 business days after NDA execution.

Data deletion & backups (recommended contractual language)
- Customer-initiated deletion: Redwood will acknowledge and begin processing a deletion request within 5 business days and complete logical deletion of live customer data within 30 calendar days.
- Backups and immutable copies: Redwood retains encrypted backups for disaster recovery; these backups are rotated and retained for a default 90-day period. For standard backup retention, full physical purge from backup media is typically completed within 90 calendar days after the initial logical deletion.
- Accelerated purge option: Upon mutual agreement and contract language, Redwood can commit to an accelerated backup purge schedule (for example, 45 days) provided the customer accepts associated operational constraints and potential increased cost. Specific timelines are evaluated on a per-deal basis and require explicit contractual language.

Logs & audit retention
- Operational logs used for debugging and platform health are retained for 90 days by default.
- Audit logs necessary for compliance can be retained longer per an add-on retention policy; please indicate required retention windows and we will provide pricing and feasibility.

Encryption & key management
- All data at rest (including backups) is encrypted using customer- or provider-managed KMS (AES-256). Access to KMS keys is logged and audited.

GDPR / DSARs
- Redwood supports Data Subject Access Requests and will provide required data or deletion confirmations within 30 days of validated requests; extended timelines may apply for complex requests as allowed under GDPR.

HIPAA / BAA
- Redwood will execute a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) with customers who are subject to HIPAA. Please route legal to legal and we will provide a standard BAA template; negotiation timelines vary but typical execution is 2–4 weeks depending on redlines.

Next steps (for Neha)
1) Paste the above into the questionnaire and return to James.
2) If Amaya needs the full SOC2 report, ask them to return an NDA and we will provide the report within 3–5 business days after NDA.
3) If they request accelerated backup purge terms, confirm and we will loop in ops/finance for feasibility/pricing.

Dev — can you confirm the operational constraints for a 45-day backup purge option and reply in-thread?
